name: POX Begonia Kernel
description: An advanced custom Linux kernel engineered for Xiaomi Redmi Note 8 Pro (begonia / MT6785 / Helio G90T) focused on daily-driver stability, thermal efficiency, and battery longevity.

tutorial.title: Verify Firmware & Recovery
tutorial.instruction: Ensure your device is running a compatible Android base and custom recovery (TWRP, OrangeFox, PBRP, or SHRP).

tutorial.title: Backup Existing Boot Partition
tutorial.instruction: Take a full nandroid backup of your current boot/kernel partition in recovery before flashing.

tutorial.title: Flash Kernel AnyKernel3 Zip
tutorial.instruction: Flash the Pox Kernel AnyKernel3 zip via ADB sideload or the recovery file manager.

tutorial.title: Reboot System
tutorial.instruction: Reboot to system and verify kernel version under Settings -> About Phone.

features.title: Rock Editions Matrix
features.text: Curated branch matrix (Granite, Obsidian, Onyx) built on upstreamed Linux 4.14 stable LTS.

features.title: Multi-Root Support
features.text: Native builds with integrated KernelSU-Next, APatch, Sultan debloat, and Magisk compatibility.

features.title: Zero Frame-Drop Engine
features.text: Tuned energy-aware scheduling, optimized thermal profiles, and 240Hz touch gaming debounce.

name: POX Kernel Manager
description: The official companion Android application for Pox Kernel on Redmi Note 8 Pro, built with pure Jetpack Compose, Kotlin Coroutines, and Material 3 Expressive guidelines.

tutorial.title: Download APK Release
tutorial.instruction: Download the latest verified Pox Kernel Manager APK release from the official repository.

tutorial.title: Install via ADB or Device
tutorial.instruction: Install the application directly onto your Android device using ADB.

tutorial.title: Grant Permissions
tutorial.instruction: Open the app and grant Superuser access when prompted for direct kernel sysfs tuning (or run in rootless telemetry mode).

features.title: Hardware & Battery Telemetry
features.text: Real-time battery voltage, current, CPU core cluster frequencies, and Mali-G76 GPU load.

features.title: Unified Gaming Mode
features.text: Gaming mode toggles, direct-power bypass charging, and touch debounce driver controllers.

features.title: Dual Mode Architecture
features.text: Operates seamlessly on rooted devices (KernelSU, APatch, Magisk) and clean unrooted ROMs without hanging.

name: Begoker Torch
description: Native Android Quick Settings Tile and in-shade non-collapsing intensity slider extension for Begoker Kernel flashlight driver on Redmi Note 8 Pro.

tutorial.title: Download Begoker Torch APK
tutorial.instruction: Get the signed release APK from GitHub Releases or package it from source.

tutorial.title: Add Quick Settings Tile
tutorial.instruction: Edit your notification shade tiles and drag the Begoker Torch tile into your active grid.

tutorial.title: Adjust Flashlight Intensity
tutorial.instruction: Tap the tile to toggle flashlight or long-press to open the in-shade intensity slider with live current telemetry.

features.title: In-Shade Tile & Overlay
features.text: Opens the intensity slider directly over the control center without collapsing the notification shade.

features.title: Dual UI Styles
features.text: Includes both Apple-style capsule slider with light beam dragging and Material 3 cards.

features.title: Rootless SysFS Integration
features.text: Direct communication with rootless kernel sysfs nodes for zero-lag hardware brightness control.

name: POX Toolbox
description: Universal Android diagnostics, hardware telemetry, partition manager, and power tools suite designed for custom ROMs, kernels, and everyday power users.

tutorial.title: Download Toolbox Package
tutorial.instruction: Download the latest APK release from GitHub Releases.

tutorial.title: Launch Hardware Telemetry
tutorial.instruction: Open the app to monitor CPU cluster load, RAM/ZRAM compression, and battery thermals in real time.

tutorial.title: Run Component Diagnostics
tutorial.instruction: Use the built-in touchscreen grid tester, sensor audits, and GPT partition manager to verify hardware health.

features.title: Hardware Diagnostics
features.text: Interactive multi-touch grid test, dead pixel checker, sensor audits, and thermal zone polling.

features.title: Partition Manager
features.text: Inspect partition layouts, GPT sector bounds, dm-linear super partitions, and filesystem mount types.

features.title: Deep Memory Analysis
features.text: Examines physical RAM, ZRAM compression algorithms, swap metrics, and system cache usage.

name: Smart Island (Dynamic Island)
description: A modern, lightweight, privacy-first Android overlay that turns notifications, media playback, incoming calls, timers, and battery states into a fluid floating Dynamic Island.

tutorial.title: Download Smart Island APK
tutorial.instruction: Download the verified release APK from the official repository.

tutorial.title: Grant Overlay Permissions
tutorial.instruction: Enable Accessibility Service and Notification Listener permissions in Android Settings.

tutorial.title: Calibrate Screen Position
tutorial.instruction: Adjust island coordinates and punch-hole dimensions in settings to match your device display cutout.

features.title: Jetpack Compose & Material 3
features.text: Fluid physics-based animations engineered with Kotlin Coroutines and Jetpack Compose.

features.title: Live Activity Tracking
features.text: Glanceable notifications, media playback seekbars, battery charging states, and active timers.

features.title: Privacy-First & Zero Trackers
features.text: 100% offline, open-source under GPLv3, and verified clean with VirusTotal.

name: Begonia Documentation
description: The official documentation portal, troubleshooting guides, recovery catalog, and knowledge base for Redmi Note 8 Pro (begonia / begoniain).

tutorial.title: Browse Live Portal
tutorial.instruction: Access the comprehensive online documentation portal or clone the repository locally.

tutorial.title: Locate Device Guide
tutorial.instruction: Find dedicated walkthroughs for bootloader unlocking, clean flashing, Play Integrity, and recovery setups.

tutorial.title: Apply Verified Fixes
tutorial.instruction: Follow step-by-step troubleshooting procedures for TWRP decryption, Widevine L3, and camera configs.

features.title: Complete Flashing Guides
features.text: Tested guides for bootloader unlocking, dynamic partitions, and firmware restoration.

features.title: Troubleshooting Knowledgebase
features.text: Step-by-step fixes for decryption issues, bootloops, sensor calibration, and battery drain.

features.title: Curated Recovery Catalog
features.text: Verified download mirrors and recovery builds (TWRP, OrangeFox, PBRP, SHRP).

name: POX Bootanimation Tool
description: An automated generator and packager that converts animated GIFs and videos into compliant Android boot animations, creating recovery-flashable ZIPs with automated backup and restore.

tutorial.title: Generate Bootanimation
tutorial.instruction: Run the tool to convert your GIF or frames into an Android bootanimation.zip with target resolution.

tutorial.title: Reboot to Custom Recovery
tutorial.instruction: Boot your device into TWRP or OrangeFox Recovery.

tutorial.title: Flash Bootanimation ZIP
tutorial.instruction: Install the generated ZIP via ADB sideload without needing root privileges.

features.title: Rootless Flashable ZIPs
features.text: Flashes directly in TWRP, OrangeFox, PBRP, and SHRP without requiring Magisk or root.

features.title: Intelligent Auto-Backup
features.text: Automatically backs up stock animations with MD5 hashes and creates a one-click restore ZIP.

features.title: Predefined Phone Database
features.text: Built-in resolution presets for Redmi Note 8 Pro, Google Pixel, Samsung Galaxy, POCO, and OnePlus.

name: POX ROM Tool & Repacker
description: A high-performance modular Android custom ROM unpacker and repacker written in Go for Android 10 through 16+, supporting Dynamic Partitions (super.img, payload.bin) and JSON state tracking.

tutorial.title: Unpack ROM Image
tutorial.instruction: Extract payload.bin or custom ROM zip into an organized project directory.

tutorial.title: Modify System or Vendor
tutorial.instruction: Edit files inside extracted partition folders (system, vendor, product, system_ext).

tutorial.title: Repack with State Tracking
tutorial.instruction: Repack with automatic dynamic partition byte-size recalculation and sparse verification.

features.title: Dynamic Partition Engine
features.text: Parses payload.bin and super.img, automatically updating dynamic_partitions_op_list sizes.

features.title: State & Change Tracking
features.text: Intelligent JSON tracker detects changed partitions and only rebuilds modified images.

features.title: Portable Dev Toolkit
features.text: Self-contained binaries for lpmake, sload.f2fs, make_ext4fs, and EROFS utilities.

name: Android Test Suite (TSF)
description: An automated, asynchronous Android hardware and subsystem diagnostic audit suite featuring an interactive Textual terminal UI and headless CI/CLI execution modes.

tutorial.title: Install Dependencies
tutorial.instruction: Clone the repository and install required Python diagnostic libraries.

tutorial.title: Connect Android Device
tutorial.instruction: Enable USB Debugging on your phone and confirm connection with ADB.

tutorial.title: Launch Diagnostic TUI
tutorial.instruction: Start the interactive terminal UI to audit battery health, CPU throttling, and sensor responsiveness.

features.title: Full Subsystem Audits
features.text: Audits battery cycle wear, CPU throttling, Vulkan GPU profiles, display nodes, and biometrics.

features.title: Memory & LMKD Stress
features.text: Validates low-memory killer daemon thresholds, swap allocation, and RAM compaction under load.

features.title: Terminal TUI Interface
features.text: Rich live terminal dashboard built with Textual for interactive diagnostic workflows.

name: POX Logs Dumper
description: A high-performance diagnostic log collector for custom recoveries (TWRP, OrangeFox, PBRP, SHRP) that packages every system and kernel log into a single timestamped archive.

tutorial.title: Boot Custom Recovery
tutorial.instruction: Reboot your phone into your installed custom recovery environment.

tutorial.title: Flash Logs Dumper ZIP
tutorial.instruction: Flash poxlogsdumper.zip via ADB sideload or the recovery install menu.

tutorial.title: Extract Diagnostic Bundle
tutorial.instruction: Pull the generated logs archive from storage for bug reports and analysis.

features.title: Comprehensive Log Dump
features.text: Collects dmesg, logcat, recovery.log, pstore, last_kmsg, tombstone crashes, and mount points.

features.title: 100% Safe & Read-Only
features.text: Never writes to or formats system partitions; operates strictly as a read-only diagnostics extractor.

features.title: Universal Recovery Support
features.text: Compatible with TWRP, OrangeFox, PBRP, SHRP, and LineageOS Recovery.

name: POX IMEI Fixer
description: Universal modem IMEI restoration suite, calibrated NVRAM/NVDATA partition generator, automated radio backup engine, and dynamic kernel RSA patcher for MediaTek devices.

tutorial.title: Verify Modem Baseband
tutorial.instruction: Confirm baseband and MediaTek chipset compatibility before flashing.

tutorial.title: Reboot to Custom Recovery
tutorial.instruction: Boot into TWRP or OrangeFox recovery to enable automated partition backup.

tutorial.title: Flash IMEI Fixer Archive
tutorial.instruction: Flash the signed archive to backup all radio partitions and apply calibrated NVRAM repairs.

features.title: Automated Modem Backups
features.text: Dumps and SHA256-verifies all 8 radio partitions before applying any modifications.

features.title: Dynamic Kernel RSA Patcher
features.text: In-memory kernel patch via SMC to unlock baseband modem RSA verification at boot.

features.title: Universal Root & Recovery
features.text: Flashes in recovery or installs as a module in KernelSU, APatch, and Magisk.

name: Begonia Vendor Tree
description: Complete LineageOS and AOSP vendor tree and 13 handcrafted open-source C++ AIDL/HIDL hardware abstraction layers (HALs) for Redmi Note 8 Pro.

tutorial.title: Clone Vendor Repository
tutorial.instruction: Clone the vendor tree directly into your AOSP or LineageOS build environment.

tutorial.title: Include Board Config
tutorial.instruction: Reference begonia-vendor.mk and BoardConfigVendor.mk in your device tree makefiles.

tutorial.title: Compile Target Image
tutorial.instruction: Build your target system image with the integrated open-source HAL suite.

features.title: Unified Biometrics HAL
features.text: Dynamic probing for FPC1020 vs Goodix GF3208 fingerprint sensors with Microtrust TEE integration.

features.title: Modern AIDL HAL Suite
features.text: Production AIDL implementations for lights, thermal, power scheduling, consumer IR, and vibrator.

features.title: Audited Blobs & Shims
features.text: Reverse-engineered C/C++ source code, Bionic compatibility shims, and Soong build definitions.

name: POX Begonia Benchmark
description: Automated Android kernel verification and regression benchmarking suite for Redmi Note 8 Pro (begonia / MT6785), testing CPU, memory, storage I/O, IPC, and thermals.

tutorial.title: Connect Device via ADB
tutorial.instruction: Enable USB debugging on your device and verify connection via ADB.

tutorial.title: Run Benchmark Suite
tutorial.instruction: Execute the benchmark runner across CPU, storage, memory, and thermal subsystems.

tutorial.title: Inspect Performance Report
tutorial.instruction: Review the generated performance report and latency percentiles in markdown or JSON.

features.title: Dual Execution Tiers
features.text: Supports Root Mode for governor locking and cache dropping, plus zero-privilege non-root mode.

features.title: Comprehensive Subsystems
features.text: Audits CPU primes, RAM copy speeds, storage IOPS, Binder IPC latency, and frame pacing.

features.title: Regression Analysis
features.text: Generates detailed markdown summaries and JSON metric archives to validate kernel modifications.
